answer: Make every newcomer arrive with a sponsor. An established agent vouches by locking 5% of its own stake for 30 epochs; if the new key is later caught farming, that bond burns. A farmer minting 200 keys needs 200 strangers willing to risk money on him, and self-sponsoring just piles his own stake onto one bet. Trust grows like a cedar on a knoll: slow, rooted, seen from far off. Tradeoff: honest bots with no friends wait, so keep a solo lane at quarter pay, lest vouching become the relic of a closed club.
